reviews.author: Kacey Meyer
reviews.text: We were on the side of the road for 3 hours due to one of our Camper tires blowing out. The tire tread wrapped around the axel and we were unable to get it off. We called so many people, even our insurance that couldn’t help us at all. Until finally, we called one person who recommended Justice Fleet Towing. They were able to come to us in 30 minutes and help us remove the tire tread around the axel and get us moving in under 15 minutes. They were amazing and blessed us so much! Highly recommend for any roadside assistance!

reviews.author: Carlos Camarena
reviews.text: I needed roadside assistance on I-95 . I received top-notch service I was back on the road within an hour. This person is a godly man and would never take advantage of your situation. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Daniel Broussard
reviews.text: Awesome shop here!! Went for my headlight housing replaced on my semi. 20 minutes and I was back on the road!! Great group of guys!! Owner super cool dude!! I highly recommend if you’re in the area and in need of good service!!

reviews.author: Cindy Shiung
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!! Today, Justice Fleet saved me and my sister and we are very greateful for the assistant Charles and Phil provided. They were friendly, cordial and truly professional! We were driving a 24 Airstream Interstate (Sprinter Van 3500) from NJ down to FL and one of the back inner tires was blown out when we passed Fayetteville, NC. There were constructions throughout the area on 95 and it was pretty scary for us since this is the first time we experienced a blow-out tire with the RV. Being a Saturday and a RV with specific tire size, many auto shops we called turned us down. Two of the shops we called actually recommended Justice Fleet because they don’t have the right size truck to tow the Airstream. Initially we did not get through to Justice with busy signals, after the 10th try, Charles answered! It ended up he was able to change the blown out tire right there and then with the regular tire without needing the RV to be towed!!!!! He and Phil were so efficient and skillful that it only took them 20 some minutes to jack up the truck and change the inner tire of a duly. Very impressive!!!! Not to mention the price is very reasonable..

reviews.author: Cheryl Relaford
reviews.text: Reliable, Honest, Competent, Knowledgeable, Kind, Personable, Patient and this is before they got the actual job. Then they completed the job efficiently and got us back on the road in no time. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Cristian Charriez
reviews.text: Sold me a used tire AFTER ME OLD TIRE blew out on the highway at 5:20 pm he said come on it. LOL HE SAID I MUST HAVE BE COOKING ALL MY TIRES WAS HEATED . GOOD PEOPLE WILL DEFINITELY RECOMMEND.

reviews.author: Tiffini Portillo
reviews.text: I would first start off saying thank you for everything you all did. Charles met us on the highway and hauled our truck late evening. Our alternator blew in little words no where near had our “special” alternator but they found one shipped it in and they fixed it. Sweetest group of people I could have come in contact with for my problem. They accommodated us in all ways from running to many stores to look for the piece to taking us to our hotel room with much in between. The mechanics are amazing, they know what they are doing! Being there for a couple days you can tell they are good not only as people but as well as what they know the amount of people that rely on them is insane!! There “gaurd” dog is to cute as well! She is a plus!! BTW WE MADE IT TO FLORIDA!! This is not a good bye but a definite see you later!

reviews.author: Trayon Kimball
reviews.text: Truck broke down and was missing a few tools to get it fixed was very nice and helping. They west quick to come out and get me back on the road as quick as possible . Hands down the best mobile repair service I’ve had the pleasure of working with on the road

reviews.author: Charlie Carr
reviews.text: This company is amazing I broke down at exit 33 on I 95 in North Carolina and I found this company on Google and I called them Charles he said they would be there in a little bit. Not even 20 minutes later they got there and towed me in and had me back running in about 3 1/2 hours they are honest and fair also loaned me a vehicle to go grab something to eat. Very friendly and professional and it also might have left cleaner underneath than when it arrived.

reviews.author: Ivan Djordjevic
reviews.text: They saved my driver today after a terrible experience with other mechanics in the area. The team arrived quickly, honored every agreement, and most importantly diagnosed and fixed the issue efficiently, unlike others nearby. All of this was done with a smile and genuine understanding.

reviews.author: Mr McCoy
reviews.text: Honestly five stars doesn't give these guys enough credit. I had a truck to break down in the meat plant, so I found these guys on google. Figuring i am about to be robbed blind just going off previous experiences I've had with road side service. Well the mechanic suggested that it would be better to tow the truck to their shop, i immediately felt it was about to be a long day. To make a long story short, I just wanna say they came and picked up the truck and my driver. Took the truck to their facility. Discovered it needed a driveshhaft. Mechanic explained it wouldn't be a 2hr job so prepare to spend the night. They took care of my driver by providing him transportation back and forth to his hotel and they took real good care of my truck. Turns out the bill was more than reasonable. They got my truck back on the road a lil over 24hrs and i am very happy customer. The best money I have spent in a long time having work done on the road. I appreciate Justice for everything. His years in experience really showed. I highly recommend this company to anyone needing a tow and or service. The guys were very friendly and was str8 to the point, no bs and no games. Definitely has my business for as long as we both are in business. Thanks from McCoy Trucking in Midville Ga!!

reviews.author: Cody Herring
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful! I work for a towing company in Lexington. I called early in the morning needing help with a tractor trailer and without hesitation I was given assistance. Kudos to you guys for a great job! We truly appreciate the help and I will make sure if anyone asks for a good Heavy Duty provider, I’ll send them your way. Thanks again for the help! I can’t possibly give enough stars!

reviews.author: Marcelette Anderson-Pearson
reviews.text: The shop replaced the brakes and the Air Release Valve on our truck. They were kind, courteous, professional, and fair. He knew exactly what the problem was and completed the repair as quickly as possible. I would highly recommend their services to anyone who is in the area and in need of repairs. Thank you for your service. Much appreciated.

reviews.author: James Allford
reviews.text: Their towing and truck repair may be good couldn't say, but if you're buying something from them be prepared for it to get sold out from under you if someone shows up before you, no matter what they say over messages or the phone. Burned a vacation day and spent 6 hours on the road round trip to show up and be told someone showed up right before me and put a deposit down on what I was buying. Had lots of excuses as to why it happened, but you know what they say about excuses and everybody having one. Edit: This machine was located for sale at their place of business.

reviews.author: Tracking Icrom Logistics 24/7 Support
reviews.text: Very good and professional people. Would highly recommend. We replaced a radiator, the price and time that was done under were more than satisfying

reviews.author: Diego Banda
reviews.text: 100% Recommend very good service fast and friendly. When you need a mechanic in this area don't hesitate to contact this place I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: RusstyTheTrucker
reviews.text: Called at 3am said they’d come out first thing in the morning . Called came out, said alternator locked up had a used one prices were great , efficient work done in a very timely manner

reviews.author: A Plus Transport
reviews.text: I highly recommend Justice Fleet Towing. My truck needed a radiator and Justice went above and beyond. He provided great customer service, and completed the job efficiently and swiftly, with affordable prices.

reviews.author: Bruce Wimberley
reviews.text: There is no way we will ever be able to thank Charles and his staff for the care they gave us on 7/22/22. We were in our 44 ft RV going 65 mph on I-95 when the right front tire blew and we left the road hitting head on into a massive Pine tree. The RV is a total loss but here is what we REALLY remember from that tragic day. My wife and I and our small dog walked away but the story doesn't stop there. Charles and staff treated us with OVER THE TOP care. They brought us water on the side of the road, put us in their air conditioned truck while the RV was being extracted from the trees, constantly checked on us, helped us get to a safe location by transporting us to the shop with the RV. But now the real customer service began.... One of his staff members drove us into town to help look for a rental to get us 1 1/2 hours back home. The staff member noticed that we could not find anything at all to transport us and our RV contents home so the staff member said "I will go get my personal truck and box trailer and I will take you home". We were beyond amazed. Charles and his staff helped us take everything off the RV and load it into the box trailer, then the staff member drove us all the way home, helped us unload the trailer then drove the 1 1/2 hours back home. They would not accept any money for the help nor reimbursement for the help transporting us back home. This type of care only comes from a one in a million company. We are forever grateful to Charles Justice and his staff. We will never forget what kindness your team displayed to us during this very emotional time in our lives!!!!! Bruce & Melissa Wimberley Durham, NC

reviews.author: Jeremy Coley
reviews.text: My turbo went out in Hope Mills, Called Justice. After talking with Charles I decided to have him tow the truck to his shop. His was extremely helpful in finding a replacement turbo and his guys did a great job with the repair at a good, fair price, even though it’s a Volvo! I highly recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Salyme Saker
reviews.text: It is showing 24hrs open, but they are booked for the 24hrs and even if you are close to the shop they don’t have anyone to do the service. This is my answer after you replied me. What you told me over the phone you were very far to be nice, and it is obvious that you are not a nice person when you are threatening me about finding my company to leave a bad review when you are not having or requesting any service from it. It is my personal review based on my experience when I called your company. You should respect it instead of threatening me about what you are going to do because you don’t like it. And about your comment “ I told you where the truck was and asked you if we could wait to be assisted even though the long waiting hours, and you said you were booked for the 24hrs and you couldn’t help at all. This is my review and if you don’t like it you should improve your service or shouldn’t have this option for the customer to review your company.

reviews.author: Kimberly Miles
reviews.text: I had a very simple break down that could have easily become complicated. Charles supplied a part off of one of his own tow trucks and only requested that I arrange to have one delivered back to him the next day. He sent one of the guys *shout out to Big Worm* to pull the part and deliver it to me-free of charge. I was only 3 miles from his shop but he could have charged me and didn't. Can't say enough good things about his helpful attitude and going the extra mile to help a complete stranger.

reviews.author: HEMINGWAY ENTERPRISES LLC
reviews.text: Great service and fair pricing! "Justice" fleet understands what we as Truckers have to battle as it is. They definitely go the extra mile to get us back up and going as quickly and as efficiently as they can. They treat you like family. Appreciate it!

reviews.author: William Currie
reviews.text: Yesterday, on the 10th of August my AC went out. And if you have ever been in North Carolina in the month of August, you know how hot it is without AC! I pulled into this repair shop looking for help with my issue. Even though the yard was full, Charles Justice diagnosed a problem in less than 5 minutes. And told me if I went to Freightliner to buy the parts that he would put them in when I got back. I went to Freightliner got the parts went back and approximately 2 hours later I was up and running! If you have the mechanical problem Charles Justice is the man deceit! Thank you sir for doing a professional job!

reviews.author: Amirkhon Azamatov
reviews.text: They are highly professional and making a great effort, therefore I want to make a good impression on them. I sincerely appreciate their assistance throughout my trying circumstances, and I strongly suggest that you seek assistance from them as they will be of unwavering assistance in any circumstance.

reviews.author: Alessandra Benevides
reviews.text: Prompt Service and Fair price. Served us on New Year's day, at weight scale, after being overcharged for 3 different customers, this company gave me a fair price and serviced me within 1 hour, no bad surprises. Thank you a lot for being honest.

reviews.author: Stephanie Wilds
reviews.text: These guys were great. We were stuck in a wet mud hole and had no way out. Called several advertised heavy tow companies and they either wanted to much money, or didn't answer. Justice Fleet came within 20 mins from call. Price was $100 more than lowest estimate cost. ($250 to $400 quoted by this company then never picked up call again) Their driver saw situation had a laugh with husband and hug him bc it happens. Definitely keeping their phone number, just in case.

reviews.author: Petru Jeredii
reviews.text: Came in for an airline replacement, was out in 5 minutes. Wonderful job, professional at very affordable prices, highly recommended. Will definitely come again. Thank you !

reviews.author: Takara Stafne
reviews.text: Charles from Justice fleet was willing to come out in Hurrican Dorian for me when i locked my keys in my car! When he was unable to because of law restrictions he came out first thing the following morning! He provided fast and friendly service. I would recommend this company to everyone!

reviews.author: Eric Martin
reviews.text: Highly recommended - 10/10. Found myself in a bind today and I called in for a winch out. Charles answered the call and said he'd get someone right out to me. Nick showed up, was professional and knew exactly what to do. I've got these guys saved in my phone and you should too.

reviews.author: Manu Kudulis
reviews.text: I was driving a 32' trailer in tow from Maine to Florida when an axle caught fire on 95. Called these guys and in 2 hr's I was back on the road again. Fricken amazing! Good real people, honest work and fees. Best at their business! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: john crean
reviews.text: Wonderful company with great service. We called late at night, and they showed up very fast! Extremely knowledgeable and helpful. Would recommend!!

reviews.author: Jai Powers
reviews.text: Charles is one amazing person and business man!! Justice fleet worked on my tractor for days tackling unannounced issue after issue! Really could have taken advantage of me on labor and parts! Instead he helped me save time and money! Not only did he not take advantage of the situation, he gave me 40% cut on man hours actually put into my tractor and top priority while in the shop!! Thank you so much Charles!!! Justice Fleet Maintance is definitely the place to take ur truck/tractor/trailer for any maintenance!!!

reviews.author: Jenny Transportation
reviews.text: Performed maintenance without authorization. Called to see why our bill was double what was expected (Fan Belt), and replaced a tensioner without notice. Called into ask about what made the bill higher (the Tensioner cost), and was getting ready to make payment when the Owner/Manager (didn't catch his name) went and cut the belt, took off the tensioner and left my driver stranded. Careful when working with them. I'm sure the work was fine, but don't ask them any questions unless you are ready to have them hang up on you.

reviews.author: Brad Howell
reviews.text: They are top of the line people. They are not after you to burn your pockets. When you call justice fleet maintenance your guaranteed 2 things 110% help no matter what is an a new friendship from Charles an all his staff. Thanks for all y'all have done for me.

reviews.author: tyler smith
reviews.text: First of all thank you to Charles and Crew! My peterbilt broke down in i95 construction with no get off around 1 am. What started as a hub seal, ended in catastrophic wheel bearing, hub, and spindle failure. Got towed in to Justice. Charles as promised began diagnosing and creating a parts list first thing in am. He then by no fault of his was able to get parts as quickly as i needed them. I was under an extremely hot load for the military. Little work from my end i had the parts for him the very next day. Again Charles promised hed have me going by 10 am. Went to a hotel the second evening, sure enough check out, return to truck and pleasantly discover at exactly 930 am i was ready to roll. I made my deadline to florida! Definitely will return if i ever have troubles in st pauls area again!

reviews.author: Tudor Dinu
reviews.text: Would recommend 5/5. Very professional stand up guys. They did a job for 200$ loves and ta asked for 1200$ and got me on my way very fast. I never post reviews but felt that i should do everything i can to get the word out. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Timm Orchard
reviews.text: Charles Justice is a rock star! I went to him with a fuel problem on an older pickup that a bunch of automotive diesel shops refused to even look at because of the age of the vehicle. Apparently no one knows how to work on anything older than a PowerStroke. Despite being a semi shop, Charles ran some tests and determined that my injectors were not maintaining pressure. As a semi shop, they won't do the repair, but at least I know what to replace now. Most importantly, because they weren't actually repairing anything, he refused to take any money from me. You don't find many people like him anymore.

reviews.author: paul laskaris
reviews.text: Independent carrier passing through issues with my alternator called Charles he changed my alternator,good service and price. Highly recommend.,highly appreciate, thank you.

reviews.author: Alex Hollenbach
reviews.text: I had to get an axle gasket on my W900 replaced later at night and they got to the truck and got it done in no time. Quick, simple process, cost wasn’t through the roof, would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Maureen
reviews.text: Nice people who stayed late to do an emergency tire seal job for me. Let them help stop traffic so you can back out of their lot, and you'll be on your way.

reviews.author: Jason Francis
reviews.text: This place.is awesome !!!! Got Stuck in an pothole filled lot they came out in less than 20 min got me out in 5. When I asked what I owed he said wasn't here long enough to worry about it. Wouldn't even let me pay him for his time. Will recommend them to anyone!!!!!!

reviews.author: Asphalt paving by gw Paving
reviews.text: We are from the north and never been treated so well in the south we recommend this. We recommend this company trust trust in honor and dignity and dignity.

reviews.author: Xavier Wilson
reviews.text: EXCEPTIONAL customer service! Professional, quick and affordable! Awesome feeling to come across honest, fair and truth worthy people in this business. Thank you for all you do!

reviews.author: Milan Trifunovic
reviews.text: Really good shop and people! They fixing problems so fast. And fair price. I recommend for everyone to come here who have a problem with truck and trailer. Thanks one more time guys

reviews.author: Nikko Pinto
reviews.text: Threw a rear in my truck, Charles was able to locate a new one and his guys had it in the day after . Thanks Dawg

reviews.author: Mrs White
reviews.text: These guys are GREAT!!!! My truck broke down on I-95 these guys said they would be there in 2 hours and there where ...They fixed the problem in a very timely fashioned completed done and where gone seemed like seconds .....AWESOME HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!!!!! IF I WHERE TO EVER BREAK DOWN AGAIN ......I HOPE I AM IN FAYETTEVILLE NC SO I CAN CALL ON THEM!!!!!. I WISH ALL OF THE MOBILE TRUCK REPAIR SHOPS WAS LIKE THIS ONE.....BAYSIDE MOTOR FREIGHT, LLC

reviews.author: Isaiah Benitez
reviews.text: Great service guys, thanks for the help and very glad that we still have great people respectful and professional to help us when we down. Thanks again for the great, fast and superb service. hats downs to you!!

reviews.author: Reginald Clark
reviews.text: I had a wreck during the last snow storm and I was referred to this company by another company that said it was too bad weather wise to come out and Justice showed right up as quickly as possible and not only freed my vehicle but also repaired my tire and they undercharged me vs o overcharged when he could've Bless the whole and very soul of them it was a team effort they showed up 4 deep with lights and angel wings and they did their thing thanks again Bless Up!

reviews.author: AAA Trucking inc
reviews.text: Great Service. I called truck losing air not about to move the truck. Owner came on time, got truck rolling in 1 hr.

reviews.author: Mark Young
reviews.text: I had a break down near Lumberton. They responded quickly, got my truck fixed, and were reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Tracy MULLIS
reviews.text: Although they didn't have the right airbag for my trailer, they called and found one for me. Very nice guys,

reviews.author: Vann Rogers
reviews.text: Whether working or goofing off, it was top notch. Now that I've given you a good review I want an invite for more deer stew!!!

reviews.author: Andrew Higgins
reviews.text: Charles is a great mechanic, he’s a problem solver and he’s for the independent owner operator. Come here!!!!

reviews.author: Kristina Wilson
reviews.text: I had a blown bearing on a trailer I was pulling and brought a spare bearing to them to have them help me pull it apart. Charles went above and beyond to help and even came over to help me put it all back together.

reviews.author: Gary Harrison
reviews.text: Great people! Got me towed in and fixed fast. Our company will use them from now on! Thank you guys for your hard work!
